name: MonikaSS After Story
source:
[b]Welcome to the madhouse![/b]
You're back in the hospital room for mentally ill people, but this time your doctor is not the founder of the Literature Club, but a trap cosplayer. That's a cool outfit he has here, isn't it?

[b]What??? Trap, who mimicking Monika, in the uniform of an SS squad?[/b]
Believe it or not, he really is a member of the Screwballs Squad, which you also happen to be in.

[b]You certainly won't get bored during the discussions...[/b]
There's a plenty of content in the game to brighten up your leisure time. But just in case, tie a pillow to the palm of your right hand (or your left hand if you're left-handed).

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://wiki.rgsr.xyz/MonikaSS_After_Story]fan game page on the Fan Translations and Translators Wiki[/url]]
translation:
[b]欢迎来到疯人院！[/b]
你又回到了精神病房，但这次你的医生不是文学部的创始人，而是一位女装角色扮演者。他这身装扮很酷，对吧？

[b]什么？？？一个扮成莫妮卡、还穿着SS小队制服的女装男生？[/b]
信不信由你，他确实是“疯子小队”的一员，而你恰好也属于这支队伍。

[b]聊天时，你绝对不会感到无聊……[/b]
游戏中有大量内容，可以为你的闲暇时光增添乐趣。不过，以防万一，最好在右手掌上绑个枕头；如果你是左撇子，就绑在左手上。

[译编自[url=https://wiki.rgsr.xyz/MonikaSS_After_Story]同人翻译与译者维基上的同人游戏页面[/url]]
